answer.evidence: The lantern cap/roof clearly shows its foreshortened elliptical top surface across rows 1-8 (approx 8 rows), with further visible top surfaces on the middle platform (rows 15-18) and base (rows 25-28) in standard 3/4 perspective.

The lantern is properly foreshortened in 3/4 top-down perspective: the domed roof shows a 7-pixel-tall top surface (rows 2-8), and both the middle platform (rows 15-18) and base plinth (rows 25-28) clearly show horizontal top surfaces seen from above.

The stone lantern features multiple tiered elliptical horizontal surfaces viewed from above: the wide roof cap shows a distinct foreshortened top surface spanning rows 2-8 (7 rows), the middle tier top spans rows 15-18, and the base platform top spans rows 25-28, correctly matching 3/4 perspective.
